metadata.scenario: A customer calls to cancel their membership, citing financial reasons. Category: Cancellation. Flags: cancellation_risk.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I assist you today? Hi, Margaret, this is Agnes Rodriguez. I hope you’re well. Hi, Agnes! It's great to hear from you. How are you doing? Well, I wanted to discuss my care services. I’m afraid I have to cancel my membership. Oh, I’m really sorry to hear that. Can I ask what prompted your decision? It’s mainly financial reasons. Things have been tight, and I just can’t afford it anymore. I completely understand, Agnes. Financial strain is tough. Yes, and I really appreciate the companionship services. They’ve helped me a lot. I’m glad to hear that. Your care is important to us, and we value you as a client. Thank you, Margaret. I just don’t think I can manage the costs right now. Would you be open to discussing alternative options? Perhaps adjusting the frequency of visits? I hadn’t thought about that. What would that look like? We could switch to less frequent companionship sessions, or even a combination of services to lower costs. That might be worth considering. What’s the price for fewer hours? For companion care, it’s $25 to $30 per hour. We could reduce it to a couple of visits a week. That sounds more manageable, but I’m still unsure if it’ll fit my budget. I can check if you qualify for any assistance programs that may help cover some costs. That would be helpful, thank you. I’ll also send you a revised care plan with different options for you to review. That sounds good. I’d appreciate having that to look over. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Agnes? Not at the moment. I think that covers everything for now. Alright, I’ll get started on those options and follow up with you shortly. Thank you, Margaret. I really appreciate your help. You’re very welcome, Agnes. We’re here for you, and I’ll talk to you soon. Bye, Margaret. Goodbye, Agnes.
